The climate in Bansko

Bansko is about 930 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 27°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −4°C. Around 880 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in March (about 110 mm).

Bansko lies at the northern foot of Pirin at about 900 m and is one of the best-known winter resorts in Bulgaria. The ski season usually runs from mid-December to April, and the slopes are much higher and colder than the town. Summers are pleasantly warm in the day, with cool nights, good for hiking in Pirin.
